checks.description: Each check the caller sees, by area in the catalogue's order; within an area, those not assessed first.

last_nightly_run.description: The latest nightly run, whose results the Compliance Center reads (FR-CTL-05).

last_run.description: The latest run of any kind.

run_requested.description: true while a Run now waits for the worker.
